attack_techniques: Steal or Forge Kerberos Tickets: Kerberoasting (T1558.003)
attackers_goals: Crack account credentials by obtaining an easy-to-crack Kerberos ticket.
description: A user specifically requested weak and deprecated encryption in a Kerberos TGS request. This provides easy-to-crack hashes and is typically a sign of a Kerberoasting attack.
investigative_actions: Check who used the host at the time of the alert to rule out a benign service or tool requesting weak Kerberos encryption.
name: Weakly-Encrypted Kerberos Ticket Requested
required_data: Palo Alto Networks Firewall traffic Logs

variations.name: Weakly-Encrypted Kerberos Ticket Requested on a sensitive server
attack_techniques: Steal or Forge Kerberos Tickets: Kerberoasting (T1558.003)
variations.description: A user specifically requested weak and deprecated encryption in a Kerberos TGS request. This provides easy-to-crack hashes and is typically a sign of a Kerberoasting attack. This action occurred on a sensitive server, which may indicate a malicious activity.
variations.attackers_goals: Crack account credentials by obtaining an easy-to-crack Kerberos ticket.
variations.investigative_actions: Check who used the host at the time of the alert to rule out a benign service or tool requesting weak Kerberos encryption.
